22163-the-rover-boys-on-the-farm-or-last.title: The Rover Boys On The Farm Or Last Days At Putnam Hall
22163-the-rover-boys-on-the-farm-or-last.creator: Unknown
22163-the-rover-boys-on-the-farm-or-last.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ng with several of their friends, and there are a number of adventures, some comical and some strange and mystifying. At the school the rivalries are as keen as ever, but the Rover boys are on their mettle, and prove their worth on more than one occasion.

arxiv-1910-07133.title: Design of a Simple Orthogonal Multiwavelet Filter by Matrix Spectral Factorization Journal: Circuits, Systems and Signal Processing
arxiv-1910-07133.creator: Vasil Kolev, Todor Cooklev, Fritz Keinert
arxiv-1910-07133.description: Abstract We consider the design of an orthogonal symmetric/antisymmetric multiwavelet from its matrix product filter by matrix spectral factorization (MSF). As a test problem, we construct a simple matrix product filter with desirable properties, and factor it using Bauer’s method, which in this case can be done in closed form.

arxiv-2006-03477.title: A stochastic kinetic scheme for multi-scale plasma transport with uncertainty quantification
arxiv-2006-03477.creator: Tianbai Xiao, Martin Frank
arxiv-2006-03477.description: Abstract Plasmas present a diverse set of behaviors in different regimes. Given the intrinsic multi-scale nature of plasma dynamics, classical theoretical and numerical methods are often employed at separate scales with corresponding assumptions and approximations. Clearly, the coarse-grained modeling may introduce considerable uncertainties between the field solutions of flow and electromagnetic variables, and the real plasma physics.

arxiv-2110-13285.title: Generative Flows as a General Purpose Solution for Inverse Problems
arxiv-2110-13285.creator: José A. Chávez
arxiv-2110-13285.description: Abstract Due to the success of generative flows to model data distributions, they have been explored in inverse problems. Given a pre-trained generative flow, previous work proposed to minimize the 2-norm of the latent variables as a regularization term. The intuition behind it was to ensure high likelihood latent variables that produce the closest restoration.

arxiv-2202-00892.title: Does Video Compression Impact Tracking Accuracy?
arxiv-2202-00892.creator: Takehiro Tanaka, Alon Harell, and Ivan V. Bajić
arxiv-2202-00892.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Takehiro Tanaka, Alon Harell, and Ivan V. Bajić. Everyone “knows” that compressing a video will degrade the accuracy of object tracking. Yet, a literature search on this topic reveals that there is very little documented evidence for this presumed fact. Part of the reason is that, until recently, there were no object tracking datasets for uncompressed video, which made studying the effects of compression on tracking accuracy difficult.

arxiv-2211-14585.title: Safety Verification of Declarative Smart Contracts
arxiv-2211-14585.creator: Haoxian Chen 1 , Lan Lu 2 , Brendan Massey 2 , Yuepeng Wang 3 and Boon Thau Loo 2
arxiv-2211-14585.description: Abstract Smart contracts manage a large number of digital assets nowadays. Bugs in these contracts have led to significant financial loss. Verifying the correctness of smart contracts is, therefore, an important task. This paper presents an automated safety verification tool, DCV, that targets declarative smart contracts written in DeCon, a logic-based domain-specific language for smart contract implementation and specification.

arxiv-2310-06780.title: On the Transcendence of Power Towers of Liouville Numbers
arxiv-2310-06780.creator: Diego Marques, Marcelo Oliveira, Pavel Trojovský
arxiv-2310-06780.description: Abstract . In this paper, among other things, we explicit a G δ G_{\delta} -dense set of Liouville numbers, for which the triple power tower of any of its elements is a transcendental number. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 11J81; Secondary 11J86 1.

arxiv-2505-22588.title: Overpartitions and Kaur, Rana, and Eyyunni’s Mex Sequences
arxiv-2505-22588.creator: Brian Hopkins, James A. Sellers
arxiv-2505-22588.description: Abstract . Kaur, Rana, and Eyyunni recently defined the mex sequence of a partition and established, by analytic methods, connections to two disparate types of partition-related objects. We make a bijection between partitions with certain mex sequences and a uniform family of overpartitions which allows us to provide combinatorial proofs of their results, as they requested.

arxiv-2507-13920.title: Reframing attention as a reinforcement learning problem for causal discovery
arxiv-2507-13920.creator: Turan Orujlu, Christian Gumbsch, Martin V. Butz, Charley M. Wu
arxiv-2507-13920.description: Abstract Formal frameworks of causality have operated largely parallel to modern trends in deep reinforcement learning (RL). However, there has been a revival of interest in formally grounding the representations learned by neural networks in causal concepts. Yet, most attempts at neural models of causality assume static causal graphs and ignore the dynamic nature of causal interactions.

arxiv-2511-13886.title: Blazars as a Potential Origin of the KM3-230213A Event
arxiv-2511-13886.creator: J. Zúñiga
arxiv-2511-13886.description: Abstract The KM3NeT collaboration has reported the detection of the highest energy neutrino event observed to date. The energy of the event is of the order of 220 ​ PeV 220\,\rm PeV hinting towards a neutrino flux at the highest energies. In this article, the potential blazar origin for this event is explored.

arxiv-2601-10209.title: Coherence Limits in Interference-Based cos(2 φ \varphi ) Qubits
arxiv-2601-10209.creator: S. Messelot, A. Leblanc, J.-S. Tettekpoe, F. Lefloch, Q. Ficheux, J. Renard, É. Dumur
arxiv-2601-10209.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by S. Messelot, A. Leblanc, J.-S. Tettekpoe, F. Lefloch, Q. Ficheux, J. Renard, É. Dumur. We investigate the coherence properties of parity-protected cos ⁡ ( 2 ​ φ ) \cos(2\varphi) qubits based on interferences between two Josephson elements in a superconducting loop.

pmc-11435916.title: Impact Load Localization Based on Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Convolutional Neural Network
pmc-11435916.creator: Shiji Wu, Xiufeng Huang, Rongwu Xu, Wenjing Yu, Guo Cheng, Karim Benzarti
pmc-11435916.description: In order to achieve impact load localization of complex structures such as ships, this paper proposes a multi-scale feature fusion convolutional neural network (MSFF-CNN) method for impact load localization. An end-to-end machine learning model is used, where the raw vibration signals of impact loads are directly fed into the network model to avoid the process of feature extraction.

pmc-11538729.title: Outcomes of elective open surgical repair or fenestrated endovascular aneurysm repair for juxtarenal abdominal aortic aneurysms in Sweden
pmc-11538729.creator: Harry H Y Yu, Giuseppe Asciutto, Nuno Dias, Anders Wanhainen, Angelos Karelis, Björn Sonesson, Kevin Mani
pmc-11538729.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundA juxtarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm is defined as a short (less than 4 mm) or no-neck aneurysm, which is often treated with open or complex endovascular repair. The evidence to support the best treatment strategy is scarce.

pmc-11620808.title: Protein Interaction Analysis and Molecular Simulation of the Anti-Inflammatory Activities in Melaleuca cajuputi Extract Against COVID‐19
pmc-11620808.creator: Agustyas Tjiptaningrum, Intanri Kurniati, Fadilah Fadilah, Tiwuk Susantiningsih, Aisyah Fitriannisa Prawiningrum, Wahyu Dian Utari, Linda Erlina
pmc-11620808.description: Coronavirus disease-19 (COVID-19) is correlated to a severe condition caused by a cytokine storm during which numerous proinflammatory cytokines, including interleukin-6 (IL-6) are released. IL-6 is a critical driver in the COVID-19 inflammatory state, and the inhibition is considered a potential treatment approach to prevent serious complications. Meanwhile, Melaleuca cajuputi is a plant with antibacterial, antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.

pmc-11654245.title: A critique of the use of species and below-species taxonomic terms for viruses—time for change?
pmc-11654245.creator: Peter Simmonds
pmc-11654245.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The International Committee for the Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) regulates assignment and names of virus species and higher taxa through its taxonomy proposal and ratification process. Despite using similar taxonomic ranks to those used elsewhere in biology, the ICTV has maintained the principle that species and other taxa are strictly categories with a formal nomenclature, whereas the viruses as objects are referenced through a parallel inventory of community-assigned virus names.

pmc-11667571.title: Transcription factor TCF4: structure, function, and associated diseases
pmc-11667571.creator: R.R. Savchenko, N.A. Skryabin
pmc-11667571.description: Our understanding of human genes – particularly their structure, functions, and regulatory mechanisms – is still limited. The biological role of approximately 20 % of human proteins has not been established yet, and the molecular functions of the known part of the proteome remain poorly understood.

pmc-11691880.title: VISUAL FUNCTIONS AND PERFORMANCE ON COGNITIVE CHALLENGE TEST IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11691880.creator: Diane Zheng, Rosie Curiel, Alexandra Ortega, Kirsten Crenshaw, Denise Carballea, Brooke Bosworth, Emory Neer, David Loewenstein
pmc-11691880.description: The Loewenstein-Acevedo Scales for Semantic Interferences and Learning (LASSI-L) is a culturally sensitive Cognitive Challenge Test (CCT) that has been shown to be predictive of preclinical Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Visual impairment is a risk factor for AD and cognitive decline. Associations between LASSI-L and visual functions in older adults have never been evaluated.

pmc-12430574.title: Antagonistic Interaction Between Microplastics and Herbivory on the Growth of Native and Invasive Plants
pmc-12430574.creator: Jeffrey Okundi, Ling Yuan, Guanlin Li, Daolin Du, Junmin Li
pmc-12430574.description: Microplastic pollution and herbivory are increasingly recognized as significant stressors in terrestrial ecosystems, yet their interactive effects on native and invasive plants remain poorly understood. In this study, we investigated the individual and combined effects of polyethylene microplastics (PE-MPs) and herbivory by Helicoverpa armigera on the growth and functional traits of twelve plant species (six invasive and six native).

pmc-12575848.title: STAT1 and m6A-mediated IL15RA upregulation promotes metastasis via ZEB1/NF-κΒ axis in ccRCC
pmc-12575848.creator: Jia Wei, Xuan’er Zhao, Huiping Wang, Cong Wang, Xinyi Liu, Zimeng Shan, Yican Guo, Xumeng Gu, Renren Li, Zhansheng Zhu
pmc-12575848.description: Interleukin-15 receptor alpha (IL15RA) demonstrates critical regulatory function in oncogenesis and immunomodulation across various malignancies. However, the role of IL15RA in cancers, such as Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma (ccRCC) remains unclear. Therefore, integrated pan-cancer analysis and mechanism investigation assays are essential for IL15RA-directed therapeutic strategy optimization in ccRCC.

pmc-12654220.title: Enhancing the Virulence of a Fungal Entomopathogen Against the Brown Planthopper by Expressing dsRNA to Suppress Host Immune Defenses
pmc-12654220.creator: Chenping Lan, Zhiguo Hu, Xiaoping Yu, Zhengliang Wang, Wolf-Rainer Abraham
pmc-12654220.description: The use of fungal entomopathogens, such as Metarhizium anisopliae, is a promising alternative for pest biocontrol but suffers the disadvantage of a relatively slower killing speed when compared with chemical pesticides. Nilaparvata lugens (brown planthopper, BPH) is a destructive sap-sucking pest that seriously threatens rice production worldwide.

pmc-12723188.title: One‐Year Clinical Evaluation of the Horizontal Mattress Sling Suture for Aesthetic Crown Lengthening
pmc-12723188.creator: Najla S. Kasabreh, Hearos A. Bedros, Dimitris N. Tatakis
pmc-12723188.description: IntroductionIn aesthetic crown lengthening (ACL) surgery, conventional suturing techniques, such as interrupted or vertical mattress sutures, involve piercing both buccal and palatal tissues. This preliminary case series introduces a new suturing approach, “the horizontal mattress sling suture” (HMSS), that eliminates the need to pierce palatal tissues and thus avoids the requirement for palatal anesthesia.

pmc-13236522.title: Successful reversal of hepatic visceral crisis in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer: a case report
pmc-13236522.creator: Joan Manuel Moreno Luján, Jorge Luis Soriano Lorenzo, Miguel Martínez Rubiño, Sònia Servitja Tormo, Tamara Martos Cárdenas, María Martínez García, Joan Albanell Mestres
pmc-13236522.description: IntroductionHepatic visceral crisis (HVC) in the setting of HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (mBC-HER2+) is an infrequent but often catastrophic presentation. Management remains particularly challenging, largely because patients with marked hepatic dysfunction are routinely excluded from clinical trials, leaving clinicians with little prospective evidence to guide decisions.

pmc-13402938.title: Color Matching Ability of a Single‐Shade or Multi‐Shade Composite Used for Lithium Disilicate Restoration Repair: Influence of Background and Shade
pmc-13402938.creator: Fatemeh Pournaghi Azar, Haleh Valizadeh-Haghi, Safa Valizadeh-Haghi

pmc-13554372.title: Dual‐Target Nectin‐4/FAP Heterobivalent Probe 68Ga/177Lu‐FZ‐NF‐1 for Triple‐Negative Breast Cancer: Preclinical Theranostic Evaluation and First‐in‐Human Translation
pmc-13554372.creator: Ye Li, Li Sun, Xiaoyu Pan, Shuyi Lin, Dongliang Wang, Jianping Zhang, Fengshuang Qiu, Bin Zhu, Lingzhou Zhao, Fengsheng Zhang, Liyan Bai, Bingxin Gu, Xiaoping Xu, Shaoli Song
pmc-13554372.description: Triple‐negative breast cancer (TNBC) features pronounced molecular heterogeneity and poor prognosis, restricting the efficacy of single‐targeted strategies. Leveraging the complementary theranostic targets fibroblast activation protein (FAP) and Nectin‐4, we designed the novel hetero‐bivalent agent FZ‐NF‐1 for dual targeting. Preclinically, both 68Ga‐labeled and 177Lu‐labeled FZ‐NF‐1 exhibited high radiochemical purity, good stability, and high affinity for both Nectin‐4 and FAP.

pmc-13601685.title: The Role of Talker Information in Phonetic Convergence
pmc-13601685.creator: Orhun Uluşahin, Elhaam Parveen Hasan, Hans Rutger Bosker, Antje S. Meyer, James M. McQueen
pmc-13601685.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The nature of the link between speech perception and production is extensively debated. One question in this debate concerns the possible use of shared representations. Talker representations encode information about particular talkers’ speech and are formed through perception. We present three experiments that investigate the potential role of talker representations in speech production as measured by their impact on phonetic convergence to voice fundamental frequency (F0).

pmc-13685304.title: Effectiveness of a nurse-led digital reminiscence program on social interaction, affect and engagement in residential dementia care: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-13685304.creator: Pablo de Lorena-Quintanal, Gina Lladó-Jordan, Esther Domínguez-Valdés, Antonia Rodríguez-Rodríguez, Carmen Sarabia-Cobo
pmc-13685304.description: BackgroundDigital reminiscence therapy (DRT) shows promise in dementia care, but evidence on social and affective outcomes in long-term care settings remains limited.MethodsA quasi-experimental study was conducted with 60 residents with dementia (Global Deterioration Scale stages 4–5) from two long-term care facilities. The intervention group received 12 nurse-led DRT sessions over six weeks, while the control group received usual care.
